ai_summary: Balaji Amines Limited reported robust consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, with revenue from operations increasing to Rs 45,592.56 Lakhs and net profit more than doubling year-over-year to Rs 7,811.77 Lakhs. This strong performance, primarily driven by the Amines & Speciality Chemicals segment, indicates healthy operational growth and is supported by an unmodified limited review report from the statutory auditors, signifying no material financial red flags.
